lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice inviting, accepting, and declining politely.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A low-pressure social invitation between colleagues after work.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Responding to invitations in a friendly way.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about going to a café, a movie, or a walk after work; one answer may be yes and one may be no.

main_focus.name: polite invitations and responses
main_focus.description: Use Vill du följa med, Ja gärna, and Tyvärr to handle simple invitations.
model_examples: Vill du följa med till caféet?
main_focus.desired_presence: Use invitation and response chunks naturally 4-6 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use polite formulas as reusable chunks and keep the social stakes low.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker invites the other to do something simple.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss timing or interest and respond politely.
dialogue_shape.ending: The invitation ends with acceptance or a friendly rain check.

focus: the reason the invitation is accepted or declined
the social outcome at the end

sentence_focus: one sentence with Vill du följa med
one sentence accepting with Ja gärna
